ASSISTANTS.TITLE: JIVO AI
ASSISTANTS.DESCRIPTION: Configure AI assistants that automatically handle conversations on your inboxes.
ASSISTANTS.EMPTY: No JIVO assistants yet. Create your first one to get started.

DELETE.TITLE: Delete JIVO Assistant
DELETE.DESCRIPTION: Are you sure you want to delete '{name}'? This cannot be undone.

SYSTEM_PROMPT.LABEL: Custom System Prompt (optional)
SYSTEM_PROMPT.PLACEHOLDER: Add custom instructions to the AI prompt...

HANDOFF_MESSAGE.LABEL: Handoff Message
HANDOFF_MESSAGE.PLACEHOLDER: Connecting you with a human agent...

INBOX_MANAGER.TITLE: Manage Inboxes - {name}
INBOX_MANAGER.DESCRIPTION: Connect this assistant to inboxes. Each inbox can have only one assistant.

DOCUMENTS.TITLE: Documents - {name}
DOCUMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Add web pages as knowledge sources. JIVO will crawl them and auto-generate FAQs.
DOCUMENTS.EMPTY: No documents yet. Add a URL to give JIVO knowledge to answer from.

FORM.NAME_PLACEHOLDER: Auto-detected from page title if blank

DELETE.TITLE: Delete Document
DELETE.DESCRIPTION: This will also remove all FAQs generated from this document.

FAQS.TITLE: FAQs - {name}
FAQS.DESCRIPTION: Question-and-answer pairs JIVO uses to answer customer questions.
FAQS.EMPTY: No FAQs yet. Add documents or create FAQs manually.

DELETE.TITLE: Delete FAQ
DELETE.DESCRIPTION: Are you sure? This cannot be undone.

TASKS.ERROR: JIVO task failed. Please try again.
TASKS.FOLLOW_UP_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. make it shorter, add a friendly tone

SUMMARIZE.TITLE: Summarize Conversation
SUMMARIZE.DESCRIPTION: Generate a concise summary of the entire conversation.

REPLY.TITLE: Suggest a Reply
REPLY.DESCRIPTION: Get an AI-drafted reply for the customer's last message.

REWRITE.TITLE: Rewrite Message
REWRITE.DESCRIPTION: Fix grammar or change the tone of any text.
REWRITE.PLACEHOLDER: Paste or type the message you want to rewrite...

LABEL.TITLE: Suggest Labels
LABEL.DESCRIPTION: Get label suggestions based on conversation content.
